# graviteeam_org_role (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM organization role

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_org_role" "example" {
  name            = "Domain Manager"
  description     = "Manages a specific domain"
  assignable_type = "DOMAIN"
  permissions     = ["DOMAIN_READ", "DOMAIN_SETTINGS"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assignable_type` (String) The assignable type of the role (PLATFORM, DOMAIN, APPLICATION, ORGANIZATION, ENVIRONMENT)
- `name` (String) The name of the organization role

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the organization role
- `permissions` (List of String) The list of permissions for this role

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the organization role
